Package org.webharvest.definition.validation

Class SchemaFactoryImpl

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.webharvest.definition.validation.SchemaFactoryImpl
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SchemaFactory, SchemaResolver
    public final class SchemaFactoryImpl
extends Object
implements SchemaFactory, SchemaResolver
    Implementation of SchemaFactory and SchemaResolver interfaces which realizes Abstract Factory and Singleton design patterns. It support multiple refresh operations. Each time, resolver refresh operation is invoked, new Set of SchemaSources is created, all previously registered SchemaResolverPostProcessors are triggered and finally using XMLConstants.W3C_XML_SCHEMA_NS_URI schema language new instance of Schema is created.
